about: A pilot asks for the lowest VFR cruising altitude on an eastbound course over a 3,200 ft floor. The model asks the engine's rule tool, the planner (stubbed) answers what the engine answers (14 CFR 91.159(a): odd thousands plus 500 eastbound, so 3,500 ft), and the model says it. test_rule_conversation.py plays the model's two turns as the Messages API streams them.
